l2tp_endpoint_detected.title: L2TP Endpoint Detected
l2tp_endpoint_detected.description: An L2TP (Layer 2 Tunneling Protocol) server is responding to SCCRQ probes on UDP/1701. L2TP is typically used with IPsec encapsulation (L2TP/IPsec) — bare L2TP without IPsec is plaintext.
l2tp_endpoint_detected.impact: If used without IPsec, all tunnel traffic is in plaintext. With IPsec, exposure is similar to other VPN endpoints (information disclosure of service availability + attack surface if daemon has known CVEs).
l2tp_endpoint_detected.remediation: Verify L2TP is paired with IPsec on this endpoint (UDP/500 + UDP/4500 should also respond). If L2TP/IPsec is intentional, ensure the IPsec configuration uses strong crypto (AES-256, SHA-256, DH group 14+). If L2TP is exposed without IPsec, disable or wrap in IPsec.
